title: Autoscaling economics insights and dynamic resize suggestions for Dedicated pools
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight recommendation engine and console surface that turns fleet telemetry into actionable resize and autoscale policy suggestions for Dedicated GPU pools. Focus scope on steady-state cost savings and low-risk adjustments: suggested min/max pool sizes, preferred GPU-mix changes, schedule-based scale plans for predictable nocturnal troughs, and burst-config recommendations. Deliver both automated recommendations and an explainable rationale surface for SRE/Platform engineers to approve before applying changes.
acceptance_criteria: Console report shows per-pool savings estimate and worst-case latency risk for top 10 Dedicated pools
API endpoint returns JSON suggestions for min/max targets and schedule windows for a given pool id
A/B experiment on two pilot pools demonstrates >=10% monthly cost reduction without violating 99th percentile latency SLO
Recommendations include the key signals used (utilization percentiles, cache hit rate, average batch size, burst frequency) and a confidence score
On-approve flow creates a change request with a rollback window and automatic monitoring alert hooks
implementation_steps: Instrument and normalize telemetry: 95th/50th/mean GPU utilization, queue time, batch size, KV cache hit rate, per-token cost estimates
Build offline backtester to simulate applying candidate min/max settings against historical traces and compute cost + SLA risk delta
Create scoring function: score = w_u * util_factor + w_c * cost_saving - w_s * sla_risk (weights configurable)
Prototype API that ingests pool_id and returns ranked resize suggestions with reasoning blobs
Console UI: per-pool panel, timeline visualization, recommended action with projected monthly USD delta and rollback button
Run pilot on 2 non-critical customer pools (consent secured), monitor 99th pct latency and cost for 4 weeks
Iterate on heuristics and add GPU-type and pre-warm indicators to avoid cold-start regressions
recommendation_examples: Pool A (g4x-heavy, steady 24/7 traffic): suggest reduce min from 8->6, keep max at 12, projected -11% monthly cost, expected 99p latency change +0.8% (low confidence)
Pool B (diurnal pattern with nightly troughs): suggest schedule-based min reduction 00:00-06:00 from 10->4, add burst bucket of 2 instances for overnight spikes, projected -18% cost
GPU-mix suggestion: swap 2 x older GPUs for 1 x newer higher-throughput instance for pooling policy when steady throughput > X tps, projected +12% perf efficiency
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: overly aggressive downsizing causes tail-latency SLO violations. Mitigation: conservative confidence threshold and mandatory pilot + canary rollout
Risk: cache-dependent workloads may appear low-util but are sensitive to KV-cache loss when instance removed. Mitigation: detect low warm-cache occupancy and annotate suggestion as unsafe
Risk: billing/commitment implications for reserved capacity. Mitigation: cross-check suggestion against reserved capacity contracts and flag any conflicts
Risk: noisy telemetry during infra incidents corrupts backtest. Mitigation: exclude known incident windows and low-signal windows from historical simulation
